dish: Serbian-style fried chicken with hot rice ('hot sauce'), vinegar slaw and fresh-cut fries
w: The 1933 birthplace of Barberton chicken: Serbian immigrants Mike and Smilka Topalsky fried chicken in lard and served it with fresh-cut fries, slaw and a tomato-rice 'hot sauce' descended from Serbian djuvece — the plate every Barberton chicken house since has copied.
